note: Neon League items, batch 5 of 5 (DC-N5), written and landed together by E18-C19: the last five mastery items. Both Halves (strike from each half of a Two-Tone lane in one attempt) unlocks Compass Pin, Split Pattern, Dry Run and Long Game; Rebound Rescue (three spares or strikes rescued by a rebound across the Career) unlocks Second Chance. New Career metrics two_tone_halves and rescues; the items use E18-C14 and C17 pieces. Amounts and prices are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: When it is knocked down on a lane that is not House Oil (Long Oil, Two-Tone or Dry Backend): +25 Value. On House Oil it gives nothing.
design.pool: Shop pin slot, from the next attempt after the Both Halves mastery.
design.presentation_needs: A pin with a compass rose on its neck whose needle swings to the match's lane; it lights off House Oil.

design.trigger: ×2 Mult on a strike when the match's lane is Two-Tone. Nothing on any other lane, and nothing on a spare or an open frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot, from the next attempt after the Both Halves mastery.
design.presentation_needs: A two-coloured oil chart, dry half and oiled half, that snaps together on a Two-Tone strike.

design.trigger: +1 Mult per pin down in the frame when a roll in it was left of the centre board at 34 ft. Nothing when every roll stayed on the right.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot, from the next attempt after the Both Halves mastery.
design.presentation_needs: Chalk tally marks on the dry left boards, one per pin down.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a strike with a curved roll when the match's lane is Long Oil. Nothing on another lane, or for a straight strike.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot, from the next attempt after the Both Halves mastery.
design.presentation_needs: A long oil streak that the ball's arc bends around at 47 ft, lit on a Long Oil curved strike.

design.trigger: ×1.5 Mult on a strike or spare when a roll in the frame rebounded off the gutter edge (Bumper Guard). Nothing in a frame without a rebound, or an open frame.
design.pool: Shop Charm slot, from the next attempt after the Rebound Rescue mastery.
design.presentation_needs: A bumper that flips a scorecard over to a fresh line when a rebound becomes a spare or strike.
